item.description: The Publishing Scotland Prize for Stirling M. Litt. item.title: Interview with Publishing Scotland CEO Sheila Pinder published in The Herald Scotland
item.description: Today our CEO Sheila Pinder's interview with Dominic Ryan was published in The Herald Scotland.
